experiment_template.research_question: Does real measured history pressure exercise safe recycling and recovery?
stop_conditions: No retry or redispatch of started trial.
Source or fixture drift blocks execution.
Stop after two trials even on failure.

success_criteria.pressure: at least one recycle, confirmed archive recovery, semantic pass, all dispatch projected bounds <=16384

falsifier: Pressure does not cause a recycle, any dispatch exceeds the hard bound, archive recovery is not confirmed, or the hidden repair check fails.
mechanism: Recent-observations-v2 masks every older observation before recycling. A bounded page of deterministic CJK code points raises token density within the single retained observation, testing measured admission and bounded archive recovery.
scope: Successor after H9-v2 counterevidence: 20700 inventory characters peaked at 6855 projected tokens and caused no recycle. Uses 4000 deterministic CJK code points as synthetic token-density load. Prospective two-trial mechanism probe at 8K, baseline then pressure; synthetic load, known task, no efficacy or generalization claim.
statement: A token-dense inspected page, unlike long low-density history, can exercise real-tokenizer recycling at 8K while preserving repair and archive recovery.
